caption: The drawing depicts two views of a ceramic jug designed in the shape of a human face. The jug is rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter tones used to create the effect of glossy, fired pottery. The face on the jug features exaggerated, sculpted eyes, a pronounced nose, and an open mouth with visible teeth. The left side of the drawing shows a frontal view, highlighting both eyes and the crooked, toothy mouth. The right side displays a three-quarters view of the same jug, revealing the handle attached to the upper rear side and the raised features from a different angle. The background is a plain, light tan color, with a faint double-line border framing the entire composition. The artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Grotesque Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
